Sam (CSM): Quick alert — NorthArc usage dropped ~70% after their internal infra change. Their ML lead started a short competitor parity test this morning. Need renewal-risk triage. :alarm_clock:
redwood-bot: [alert] account_usage_drop: NorthArc (acct_9902) - 70% WoW. AlertID: UDF-9902-07
Priya (AE): yikes. Who's the active champion? any procurement chatter?
Sam (CSM): Champion (Diego) still engaged but said they had "throughput problems" last week. Mentioned evaluating "AltInference" for a 2-week pilot.
Omar (SE): Telemetry snippet (tokens/day):```
2026-06-01: 62,100
2026-06-02: 59,400
2026-06-03: 18,300
2026-06-04: 9,800
2026-06-05: 6,200
2026-06-06: 4,500
```
Lena (CS Ops): Playbook suggestion: 1) 20m triage call within 24h; 2) offer a short controlled parity bench on our infra (48-72h); 3) provide regression against their core prompt-set and a one-page SLAs+cost-sensitivity note. I'll schedule.
Priya (AE): Commercial side: propose an "env-parity" credit covering infra for the bench and ask for competitor pilot scope + success metrics. Can someone pull last 60d evals?
Omar (SE): I'll assemble a quick regression report and a perf-repro recipe. Plan: pin q4_8bit, enable prefix cache for retrieval-heavy flows, and force small batches for latency routes. Example toggle:```
PATCH /v1/accounts/9902/config
{ "prefix_cache": true, "batch_target": 4 }
```
Sam (CSM): Action items: Priya - lead outreach + extract competitor metrics; Omar - repro recipe + regression before call; Lena - book 20m and attach materials; Sam - prep renewal-risk summary and flag exec-escalation if pilot scope looks like replacement.
Lena (CS Ops): Booked 20m with Diego for 2026-06-07 11:00 PT. Agenda: usage trend, competitor pilot scope, demo of cache/quant wins, env-parity offer. Invite includes telemetry + repro link.
Priya (AE): On the call I'll ask for permission to run a constrained A/B (we host our variant) and request their success criteria in writing. If they insist on in-house runs, ask for same-hardware comparison.
Omar (SE): Quick perf note to share on call: enabling prefix caching + pinned quant typically reduces p50 latency 140ms -> 80ms on similar retrieval routes. I'll drop the one-pager to the invite now.
redwood-bot: [note] alert acknowledged by Sam at 2026-06-06T16:22:10Z
Sam (CSM): If they confirm a competitor side-by-side, escalate to Director CS for a 7-day QBR. Case# CS-9902-ENV_CHECK. Keep replies short for handoff.
Priya (AE): 👍 will update after the 6/7 call.
